# Back-test regression ratchet.
#
# The model FAILS its own interval standard today: 2 of 10 arms cover the
# observation at 95%, against a required 0.80, and EVERY arm under-predicts
# (percent error -16.23% to -3.14%). That is systematic bias, not Monte Carlo
# noise, and it is an outstanding scientific defect -- see the interval warning
# emitted by the supply engine.
#
# These values are NOT a target and NOT an acceptance threshold. They record
# where the defect stands so it cannot get quietly worse while it is being
# fixed. Coverage may only rise; worst-arm bias may only shrink; arms may not be
# dropped, because deleting a failing arm is not an improvement.
#
# Seeded 2026-08-15 from artifacts/backtest_2020_to_2023_summary.csv

# Definition-matched arms only (apply_attrition == observed_applies_attrition).
# Recorded ALONGSIDE the all-arms figure, never instead of it.
